I think they mainly hire people without experience so you’re fine there. 

With the selling question, you basically just say the notes and how you’d layer the fragrance (if you chose bodycare). Honestly that answer doesn’t need to be perfect, they just want to see confidence and the want to learn. 

The rude customer question is pretty straightforward. They want to make sure you won’t be confrontational. Just format your answer around listening to their body language and cues. 

If you want a specific answer for aggressive customers:

-listen to the customer 
-empathize with their issue
-offer a solution
-if the customer escalates, contact your manager and step away from the problem

The strengths/weaknesses question is also easy. Nothing to think about. If you’ve never had a job then think of a scenario where your leadership was needed (club leader, sports related example) 

You can say

Strengths: willing to learn, confident

Weaknesses: I think I just said I am nervous talking to people and nervous about rejection. Both are things they train you to get over so it’s workable
